endpointAccuracy.externalNote: BFCL: A small (4.3%) portion of tool-use requests fail on this endpoint due to a server-side tool handling error.

This is DeepInfra's throughput-optimized 'Turbo' endpoint. It caps output at 16,384 tokens, so roughly half the long HLE answers are cut off before finishing - much lower HLE than DeepInfra's standard endpoint.
On tool use (BFCL), this endpoint frequently produces invalid function-call arguments, so many calls are marked incorrect.

On tool use, about 7% of tasks fail because Groq's API rejects function calls whose arguments don't exactly match the tool's schema (e.g. a year sent as text, not a number). The model keeps producing the same arguments, so retries don't help. On HLE, some long answers are cut off at Groq's 65,000-token output limit.
This endpoint caps output at 32,768 tokens. On HLE, whose hardest questions need longer answers, roughly a quarter are cut off before the model finishes, which lowers the score.
This endpoint caps output at 32,000 tokens, which slightly lowers the HLE score.
